data.gender_notes: Zamariel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew elements 'zamah' (remembrance, memorial) and 'el' (God). This name may be connected to the biblical figure Zamar, who played the lyre and sang songs to God. The name Zamariel carries the meaning “My right is El” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Zamariel usually hope their child will grow to embody my right is el and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of devotion and remembrance of God.
data.etymology: Zamariel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “My right is El.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Zamariel total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: זמריאל

in_greek.name: Ζαμαριήλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ζαμαριήλ είναι eine σύνθεση των λεξικών ζη και 마ριελ, και σημαίνει ο Θεός θυμάται το τραγούδι, στην Καινή Διαθήκη nicht αναφέρεται, αλλά στην παλαιά διαθήκη αναφέρεται ως όνομα αγγέλου, και θεωρείται ως όνομα δημοφιλές στην χριστιανική παράδοση

in_latin.name: Zamariel
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Zamariel est compositum ex duobus partibus, zam et mariel, et significat Deus memorat cantum, in traditione christiana non est commune, sed in biblia hebraica apparet ut nomen angeli, et habet significatum spirituale in cultu christiano

in_english.name: Zamariel
in_english.long_meaning: The name Zamariel is derived from Hebrew roots, meaning God remembers the song, it appears in the Bible as an angel's name, and is considered a unique and spiritual name in Christian tradition, associated with musical and poetic talents

data.cultural_impact: The name Zamariel may evoke images of ancient Jewish musicians playing sacred instruments and singing praises to the Lord. It may also remind one of the importance of music and art in expressing our connection to the divine.
data.spiritual_significance: Zamariel can be seen as a personal reminder to remember and honor God in our daily lives through creative expression and musical praise, much like the ancient figure of Zamar. Additionally, the name can be seen as a call to be a memorial, a living testimony of God's love and grace in our lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Zamariel, meaning "God of the West," symbolizes the protective presence of God in the unknown and unfamiliar directions of life. It encourages embracing change and trusting in His guidance during new beginnings.

biblical_reference.note: Zamariel is mentioned as one of the seven angels who stand before God
